# Seenzo

> Seenzo is India's AI Visibility platform. It scans how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude describe a business and delivers a free AI Visibility Report with a prioritised, plain-English fix list. Built by KlivIQ Technologies OPC Private Limited.

Seenzo helps Indian businesses get discovered inside generative AI answer engines (GEO / AEO). A scan produces an AI Visibility Score (0–100), an engine-by-engine breakdown across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude, six category scores (Crawlability, Structured Data, Metadata, Content Quality, India Presence, Trust), India-specific directory and GST checks, and a prioritised fix list the business can act on the same week. Reports are delivered by email after email verification.
